title: Engineer II-Network Engring
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
 As a network engineer, your primary responsibility will be to develop and maintain Python scripts to automate workflows for the Wireless NMC.
   

  

* You will also conduct data analysis, diving deep into wireless trouble tickets and alarms to identify trends and their business impact.
* A key aspect of your role will be to interpret wireless network trouble ticket worklog entries by understanding existing automation workflows to effectively answer end\-user questions.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You are a natural communicator who can adapt your style and approach to meet the diverse needs of various team members and stakeholders. People trust your judgement and seek your advice. You excel at connecting data from different sources and synthesising it into a cohesive, complete picture. You thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment with multiple hit\-visibility projects and competing priorities.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant work experience.
* Advanced knowledge of operating systems and applications.
* Proficiency in computing programming.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting skills for analyzing complex solutions and problems.
* Experience with Oracle/SQL database administration.
* The ability to quickly learn, adapt, and convert code to new scripting languages.
* Willingness to work a schedule that includes overlap with the US day shift (specifically for weekly meetings and initial training).


**Even Better If You Have**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or Economics.
* Experience with large\-scale IT systems.
* Python certification.
* Experience with JavaScript \& React for web\-based tool development.
* Project management skills.
* Experience providing support to hundreds of users of developed applications.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a commitment to quality and user satisfaction.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
